notes: Stories defined for Brain lock TTL, ownership, and recovery.

stories.title: Brain Lock Schema and Ownership Contract
stories.description: Define MongoDB schema and contract for Brain locks including fields: lock_id, owner_id (agent/service), acquired_at, expires_at (TTL), status (active/expired/recovered), and recovery_token. Establish validation and ownership rules.

stories.title: Lock TTL Enforcement and Expiration Engine
stories.description: Implement core logic to enforce TTL on Brain locks, including automatic expiration checks, rejection of expired locks, and safe re-acquisition after expiration.

stories.title: Lock Ownership Validation and Conflict Resolution
stories.description: Implement ownership validation to ensure only the lock owner can operate under an active lock. Add conflict resolution logic for concurrent acquisition attempts and stale lock detection.

stories.title: Lock Recovery and Manual Override Mechanism
stories.description: Implement recovery workflow for orphaned or stuck locks, including admin override or recovery token mechanism to safely release or transfer lock ownership.

stories.title: Lock Lifecycle Testing and Integration
stories.description: Develop unit and integration tests covering lock acquisition, TTL expiration, ownership enforcement, conflict scenarios, and recovery workflows within Brain runner and Machine Brain operations.
